latestVersion.changelog:
Script-to-Video AI skill initial release.

- Instantly converts user-uploaded scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT) into AI-generated videos with visuals, voiceover, and subtitles.
- Handles backend authentication and session management automatically, granting 100 free credits for 7 days.
- Supports 1080p MP4 export with fast cloud GPU rendering (typical jobs take 1–2 minutes).
- Provides upload, preview, status, and export commands; summarizes timeline edits in plain text.
- Guides users with clear error messages, supported formats, and actionable tips for best results.
